checks.name: Initial Administrator Credential Hardening
checks.details: Generated high-entropy password (len=27), no hardcoded credentials, must_change_password=True

checks.name: Mandatory Password Change & Re-Authentication
checks.details: Initial login requires change, password updated securely, subsequent login has must_change_password=False

checks.name: Cryptographic Session Token Hashing (SHA-256) & CSRF Nonce
checks.details: Plaintext token never persisted in DB; only SHA-256 digest is stored in admin_sessions; CSRF nonces validated

checks.name: Sentinel Gate & Defense-in-Depth Policy Bypass Resistance
checks.details: Direct tool invocation with imported sentinel denied (policy_denied=True); registry rejects out-of-scope targets

checks.name: Layer 1 Socket SSRF, Rebinding & Cloud Metadata Protection
checks.details: 169.254.169.254, 0.0.0.0, 224.0.0.1, and 255.255.255.255 strictly rejected by Layer 1 socket validator

checks.name: Role-Based Access Control Privilege Segregation
checks.details: Admin, Operator, and Auditor roles properly configured with distinct permission boundaries
